name: IconButton
summary: Icon-only button with a required accessible label.

a11y.keyboardNote: Measured in a browser on 27/08/2026. Both confirmed: it is a real <button>, and the platform delivers the two keys. The bank needs a handler with an observable effect — a button whose onClick does nothing reads as an inert key in a DOM snapshot, which is a limitation of the method and not of the component.

props.name: label
props.description: REQUIRED. Becomes aria-label: an icon with no text has no accessible name without it.

props.name: icon
props.description: Carbon glyph, from the contract's allowlist.

props.name: variant
props.description: Same eleven variants as Button. Ghost by default, so a row of them stays quiet.

props.name: appearance
props.description: Herdado do Button. Quanto peso a caixa tem; o default aqui é ghost.

props.name: tone
props.type: neutral | brand | danger | success | warning | info
props.description: Herdado do Button. O que a cor significa; todas as células existem.

props.name: size
props.description: Square target: the width follows the same density token as the height.

props.name: loading
props.description: Spinner in place of the glyph, aria-busy set, interaction blocked.

props.name: href
props.description: Renders an anchor with the same skin, like Button.

props.name: leadingIcon
props.description: A second glyph before the main one. Rare on an icon button, and it is here because the type is shared with Button.

props.name: trailingIcon
props.description: A glyph after the main one — a chevron on a button that opens a menu, for instance.

props.name: kbd
props.description: Shows the shortcut inside the button AND announces it with aria-keyshortcuts. Showing it without announcing would be decoration.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Fills the width of the container instead of hugging the glyph.

props.name: grow
props.description: In a row (Cluster), takes an equal share with the other buttons that also grow (C-03). `fullWidth` asks for the whole line instead.

props.name: target
props.description: Link attribute, only with `href` (C-13). It always reached the <a> at runtime; now the type accepts it, so target="_blank" compiles.
